name: Chemical Nomenclature & Structure Representation
summary: The systematic naming of compounds and the drawn and machine-readable ways chemists represent structures.

topics.name: IUPAC inorganic nomenclature: binary and ternary compounds, acids, hydrates
Organic nomenclature: parent chains, substituents, functional-group priority
Structural formulas: Lewis, condensed, skeletal, wedge-dash, Newman and Fischer
Machine-readable representations: SMILES, InChI/InChIKey and molfiles
CAS Registry Numbers and other chemical identifiers
